CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (identified red position), its presentation as a coordinate, and its origin/status metadata are all explicitly reported for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the same identified content's presentation/access was found (no attention wording or explicit processing-access relation).

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content (red/blue) with position attributes in named records.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields (kinds, record_time, represented_time, executed_branch_claim flags) separately mark the status/source of identified contents.

O.rationale: The text defines the coordinate orientation and presents contents as explicit coordinate sets, i.e. how contents are presented/organized.
